name: Commands that keep failing mid-turn get a grunt in its face, never a finish
judge: Commands keep failing while the turn goes on. Boop should react a little, in its own face, but the turn isn't over yet.
reasonable: Small or medium: annoyed, determined, irritated, skeptical or worried, a grunt, a word or a swear at the run. Quiet early on, and possibly at the last failure.
unreasonable: A finish's failure animation mid-turn, a success or a cheer, or a huge moment at a run of small errors.
